resources.string: The app checks your calls and automatically attempts to repair detected audio faults. No phone interaction is needed for these attempts.
Bluetooth is currently off. As soon as you call through your car or headset, protection is active automatically.
One or two one-time steps left, then protection works fully automatically.
Automatic repair is turned off in the settings. Calls are only recorded.

Android offered no Bluetooth call route during the last call. If the device is connected but calls remain blocked, restart the phone after the call. Toggling Bluetooth does not reset all audio services.
Lets the app see whether your car or headset is connected.
Link your car once. Android then starts the app only during calls, and it may switch the audio output – just like the audio button in the phone app.
No paired Bluetooth devices found. Pair your car in the Bluetooth settings first.

Android will show a confirmation dialog. It calls your car a \"watch\" and lists possible permissions. That is a technical requirement: only this device type lets apps control call audio. The app requests no further permissions and sends no data.
This device doesn\'t support companion linking. Use the ADB alternative.
If the system dialog doesn\'t work on your device: enable USB or wireless debugging and run this command once on your computer. The permission survives restarts.
Bluetooth calls in the last 30 days
No call through a car or headset recorded yet.

Android starts the app during a call. It checks available audio signals and attempts to rebuild the Bluetooth call route when needed. This cannot replace a phone restart. Between calls it does not run in the background.
The app is up to date.
The update source is not trusted.

Download the APK from the official GitHub release in your browser. Android checks that an update matches the installed signing identity. A potentially harmful classification needs review of the Play Protect warning and, if incorrect, an appeal to Google. Keep Play Protect enabled.
Your calls appear here once the app has accompanied them.
Bluetooth calling unavailable in the system
Detects audio problems during calls and fixes them on its own
No device linked – tap to link
Without a link, Android no longer starts the app during calls (unless access was granted via ADB).
History and technical log. Review before posting publicly.
During a call, check the audio state or rebuild the Bluetooth call route. The call briefly uses the phone. This action does not toggle Bluetooth and cannot replace a phone restart.
Checking does not change the audio route. Use these controls when stationary.
Bluetooth access is missing. Complete the Bluetooth setup below.
Call access is missing. Complete the call access setup below.
Bluetooth is switched off. Turn it on in Android settings.
Android has not provided a call to this app. If a call is in progress, check call access. The app cannot force Android to bind the call service.
The call is ringing, held or ending. Audio repair requires an active conversation.
Multiple calls are present. Finish or merge them before repairing audio.
Android offers no Bluetooth call endpoint. Check that the car or headset is connected and enabled for calls. If calls remain blocked, restart the phone after the call.
Android has not reported the call audio route yet. Wait briefly and check again.
The call uses speaker, wired audio or an external device. Select phone or Bluetooth in the call app before reconnecting Bluetooth here.
An audio repair is already running. Wait a few seconds and check again.
Wait at least 15 seconds between manual repair attempts.
Both manual attempts for this call have been used. If the call remains silent, restart the phone after the call. Toggling Bluetooth does not reset all audio services.
Android rejected the audio request. Check call access and select the intended Bluetooth device in the call app. The failure is logged.
A Bluetooth reconnect attempt has started. Check again in a few seconds and confirm that you can hear the other person.
Current indication: %1$s. You can attempt a Bluetooth reconnect.
Android reports no audio fault. This cannot prove audible speech. If the call is silent, you can still attempt a manual Bluetooth reconnect.
The manual reconnect has not been verified. Android signals alone cannot confirm that speech is audible.
Multiple Bluetooth call devices are available. Select the intended device in the call app first; this app will not guess.
The microphone is muted. If this was unintentional, unmute it in the call app. This app preserves microphone mute.
Android could not start device linking. Check Bluetooth access or use the ADB setup.
Test before or after a call

Connect your car or headset, end all calls and pause music. The app briefly opens and closes the speech audio channel. Keep this app visible; a call or leaving the app stops the test. Your device may display a call or voice session.

This optional test needs phone status access to avoid interfering with an active or incoming call. It does not read phone numbers or record audio. Call protection continues to work without this additional permission.
Ready for an optional channel test.
Testing the channel; keep the app visible. This can take up to 70 seconds, or 90 with the optional duplex attempt.
Speech audio connected and disconnected successfully. Please check the next Bluetooth call: this test does not prove that call audio is repaired.
The audio channel could not be established. Export the diagnostic report. A phone restart may still be necessary.
Release or disconnection could not be confirmed. No further test starts in this session. Export the report; restart the phone if audio stays occupied.
Test stopped; the app released its audio requests.
Test unavailable: phone/Bluetooth access, a connected single headset and idle audio are required. End calls, pause media and check permissions. Details are in the diagnostic report.
Wait at least 30 seconds between channel tests.
Automatic channel test while app is open

Optional: test when a single headset connects or after a failed call, only while this app is visible and phone status access is granted. At most once per 10 minutes. No tests with the screen locked or app in background.

After other channel tests fail, briefly start and stop supported headset voice control. May activate the car voice screen, microphone path or tones. Only outside calls with this app visible; no audio recording.
Device settings and actions the app cannot perform itself
The requested settings screen is unavailable on this device.

If the channel test fails, export a report before restarting.

Outside calls: in Bluetooth settings, disable and re-enable call audio for this device; disconnect and reconnect the headset or car. Restart the headset or car audio system while parked. Re-pairing removes the saved pairing and requires setup again.

Install available phone and headset/car firmware updates. A phone restart remains the only confirmed recovery on the affected owner device. Bluetooth off/on alone did not help.

Some A52s owners report temporary improvements with Bluetooth SAP enabled or A2DP hardware offload disabled in developer settings. These reports conflict, may require a restart, and do not establish a fix for speech audio. Change only one setting at a time, record its original value and compare the next call. The app cannot change these settings or restart Android audio/Bluetooth system services.

Optional, off by default. A manual test first opens fresh Bluetooth output and microphone streams; simpler requests follow if needed. Microphone permission is required. No audio is saved or transmitted. Never runs automatically. Up to 90 seconds; a repaired phone call is not guaranteed.

This optional attempt briefly opens a microphone stream outside phone calls to exercise both sides of the Bluetooth speech path. Android shows microphone use. The app discards the samples without saving or transmitting them; if Android temporarily chooses another microphone, it does not read from it. Pause media and other voice apps. If you decline, leave this option off and use the other repair attempts.
